description: Oganesson is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Og and atomic number 118. It is a p-block element and a member of group 18 on the periodic table of the elements, representing the last member of period 7. It has the highest atomic number and highest atomic mass of all known elements.
characteristics: Its only known isotope, oganesson-294, is highly radioactive with a half-life of 0.7 milliseconds. Theoretical studies predict that due to relativistic effects, it would be a solid at room temperature and significantly reactive, unlike the other noble gases. The element was first synthesized in 2002 at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia.
